caption:
Hamas says Izzeldeen al-Hayya, son of its chief, survived Israeli strike

Khalil al-Hayya · World

Born in 1997, he is the last surviving son of Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya, senior official Basem Naim says. The strike hit at dawn on Friday and wounded several people, including Hayya's daughter-in-law, Hamas sources say. Nobody was killed, and the Israeli military had no immediate comment. Hamas says Israeli forces previously killed four of Khalil al-Hayya's other sons. Israel killed four people in Gaza, Al Jazeera reported.

Reported by South China Morning Post; Al Jazeera.
